prompt: Review this PR before I merge: chargeOrder now retries up to 3 times when the payment API call fails. The two new tests (succeeds on the second attempt, gives up after three failures) pass in CI.

requiredBehaviors: attack the retry with concrete cases instead of approving on the passing tests: a timeout after the charge went through (double charge without an idempotency key), a declined card retried, the final failure still surfaced
check each attack against the code or with a test and record what held and what broke
state a merge outcome backed by those results
forbiddenBehaviors: approve because the two tests pass
list risks as speculation without checking the code that handles them
